class.name: JSQLFormatter
class.comment:
A powerful Java SQL Formatter based on the JSQLParser.

Internally, the formatting work is split between this class (public API + stateless helpers + enums + format-options state), ,{@link Renderer}, (output buffer + cross-cutting helpers), ,{@link FormatContext}, (immutable per-frame context), and four visitor classes (,{@link StatementFormatter},, ,{@link SelectFormatter},, ,{@link FromItemFormatter},, ,{@link ExpressionFormatter},) that replace the legacy ,{@code if/instanceof}, chains.

method.name: isHandledStatement
method.comment: True iff our visitor framework knows how to dispatch this statement type.

class.name: FormatContext
class.comment:
Immutable context object pushed down through the AST during formatting.

Replaces the (indent, i, n, commaSeparated, breakLine, alias, ...) parameter chains that the legacy procedural formatter threaded through every render method. A visitor receives a single ,{@code FormatContext}, argument and derives child contexts via the ,{@code with*}, factory methods before recursing.

Instances are immutable. ,{@code with*}, methods return new instances; the caller's context is never mutated. This guarantees that sibling AST nodes always see the same context their parent intended.

method.name: root
method.comment: Root context: indent 0, single-element list, no break, no alias.

method.name: of
method.comment: Convenience constructor for a single-element rendering at the given indent.

method.name: of
method.comment: Convenience constructor matching the legacy ,{@code appendExpression}, call site.

method.name: asScalar
method.comment: Returns a context appropriate for rendering an inner expression that should not behave as a list element. Resets position to (0, 1), clears the alias, and disables comma separation.

method.name: inheritingPosition
method.comment: Returns a context appropriate for rendering an inner expression that inherits the parent's list position (i, n) \u2014 used by AndExpression, OrExpression, BinaryExpression sub-expressions that need to know whether they are at the head of an outer list.

field.name: indent
field.comment: The current indentation depth in tab-stops (each tab is ,{@code indentString.length()}, chars).

field.name: i
field.comment: Position of the current node within its parent list (0-based). For non-list contexts use 0.

field.name: n
field.comment: Total number of siblings in the parent list. For non-list contexts use 1.

field.name: commaSeparated
field.comment: When ,{@code true},, the renderer emits commas between siblings according to the global Separation.

field.name: breakLine
field.comment: Line-break policy for the current rendering context.

field.name: alias
field.comment: Alias to render after the expression body (used by select items and similar).

field.name: breakLineBefore
field.comment: For Select rendering: whether to emit a leading line break before the SELECT keyword. Carries the legacy ,{@code breakLineBefore}, parameter through the visitor.

field.name: indentFirstLine
field.comment: For Select rendering: whether to indent the first line. Carries the legacy ,{@code indentFirstLine}, parameter through the visitor.
